text: [excited] Third man fine है, लेकिन Fineleg अंदर — [slow] ये uppercut के लिए trap जैसा है...
english: Third man is back, but Fineleg is inside the circle — it looks like a trap for the uppercut...

text: [excited] Power का option है, [slow] लेकिन cover tight है.
english: Power is an option, but cover is tight.

text: [shouts] Kohli down the ground — [shouts] ग़ज़ब की timing, और SIIIIX!
english: Kohli goes down the ground — tremendous timing, and SIX!

text: [excited] 68 off 49 पर Kohli ने gear बदल दिया है, [shouts] ये वही class है!
english: Kohli has switched gears on 68 off 49, this is that class!

text: [shouts] क्या shot है ये — अद्भुत, पूरी class!
english: What a shot this is — absolutely superb, pure class!
